mapper.sql: e.id, e.emp_no, e.name, e.gender, e.phone, e.email, e.company_id, e.dept_id, e.position_id, e.hire_date, e.status, e.created_at, e.updated_at
c.company_name AS companyName, d.dept_name AS deptName, p.position_name AS positionName
LEFT JOIN org_company c ON c.id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN org_department d ON d.id = e.dept_id LEFT JOIN org_position p ON p.id = e.position_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_employee WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hr_employee (emp_no, name, gender, phone, email, company_id, dept_id, position_id, hire_date, status) VALUES (#{empNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{companyId}, #{deptId}, #{positionId}, #{hireDate}, #{status})
